title: Ordinary exchange is invertible on strict-local global sections
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism f:X→S [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a geometric point s:Spec Omega→S [def-weil-geometric-point], and an abelian etale sheaf F on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], put g:S_(s)→S for the small-model strict-henselization structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Applying Gamma(S_(s),-) [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor] to the ordinary base-change map g^-1 f_*F→f'_*(p^-1 F) [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] gives an isomorphism of abelian groups.

proof.text: For an arbitrary commutative square of schemes, identify the derived adjunction mate with derivedBaseChangeMapPlus using its universal property, Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac and pullbackSquareComparison_hom_app_factorsh (proved private mate_eq_derivedExchange). On the single complex F[0] of an abelian sheaf, use derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_fac_app. Left exactness makes both right-derived units invertible on degree-zero homology; exact inverse image transports the first unit comparison. The mapped factorization gives an isomorphism of arrows to homology of levelwise ordinary exchange. Single-complex homology and naturality identify the latter with ordinary exchange. Private ordinaryExchangeArrowIso proves the arrow comparison for four abstract additive functors between abelian categories; the main proof instantiates it with the inverse/direct images of AddCommGrpCat-valued sheaves. This abstracts the expensive homotopy-composition conversion before substituting the scheme functors.

Specialize ordinaryExchangeArrowIso to the strict-henselization pullback square and map the arrow isomorphism through global sections. Apply smallModel_isIso_strictHenselization_baseChange_globalHomology to F[0] in degree zero and rewrite its mate by mate_eq_derivedExchange. Transfer invertibility along the resulting arrow isomorphism to obtain the ordinary assertion.

theorem isIso_strictLocalOrdinaryDirectImageComparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        ((baseChangeMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f
            (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).app F))
